notes: Exact LOC original item pages and public source MP3 URLs. No byte-level hash or availability check has been completed for this batch. All are pre-1923 sound recordings in the United States.

tracks.title: Na falach Dunaju (Waves of the Danube)
tracks.performers: Julja Pijanowska (soprano); Nathaniel Shilkret (conductor); Iosif Ivanovici (Romanian composer)
tracks.context: Romanian composer's waltz performed in Polish by a US-recorded vocalist. Not a Romanian radio broadcast.

tracks.title: Lu Lu Fado — Le vrai fado portugais
tracks.performers: Conway's Band; Patrick Conway (conductor); Nicolino Milano (composer)
tracks.context: U.S. band's 1914 fado-inspired dance, associated with Portuguese fado, not an authentic Portuguese fadista performance.

tracks.title: Hungarian Rhapsody No. 2
tracks.performers: Arthur Pryor's Band; Franz Liszt (Hungarian composer)
tracks.context: An American band's genuine early recording of Hungarian composer Liszt's orchestral repertoire.

tracks.title: Rekruti
tracks.performers: A. Bartos and F. R. Běláč (vocals); Anton Grill (composer)
tracks.context: Original Bohemian/Czech-language historical vocal recording. Recorded before Czechoslovakia existed.
